Salida Overnight

Road Book · checked Nov 23, 2026 · not saved yet

⌂ CatalogBeforeD1FunQuickHelp

Out to Salida on back roads, home over the passes. Day 2 has two versions: pick fun or quick on the morning. No closure was found on any of the three, but fuel and mud on day 1 need a plan.

Using it offline

  • Nothing to download: opening this page with a signal saves it. When the top says ✔ saved for offline, it's on this phone: page, maps, strips, GPX files and the weather.
  • Then open the same address without a signal. Easiest: in Chrome, ⋮ then Add to Home screen (iPhone: Share, then Add to Home Screen).
  • The night before, open it with a signal: that gets the latest version and a fresh forecast for the dates you set below.
  • It stays until you clear the browser's data. Try it once in airplane mode before you leave.

Weather and what to wear

At the hour you'd be at each place. Within 16 days: a forecast. Further out: the last five years.

Go or no-go

Your ticks stay on this device.

  • ✔ No issue found · Day 1, mile 96

    South Platte bridge, 5 mi north of Deckers

    Deck replaced in 2026; the county lists it as done.

    Jefferson County, Aug 4, 2026

  • ✔ No issue found · Day 1, mile 58

    CO 74 in Evergreen

    Resurfacing finished in November 2026.

    CDOT

  • ⚠ Check · Day 2, fun and Day 2, quick, mile 103-121 (fun), 70-88 (quick)

    Boreas Pass Road

    Gates close for the winter; opens about mid to late May, later in a big snow year (TerraTrack's map data: closed January to April). No 2026 closure or damage notice found. Closed? US 285 and CO 9 over Hoosier Pass, 31 mi to Breckenridge, paved.

    White River and Pike forests · ☎ Dillon Ranger District 970-468-5400; South Park 719-836-2031

  • ⚠ Check · Day 2, fun, mile 53-79

    Weston Pass

    No 2026 closure found, but no official status page either. The Lake County (west) side can be rough, and a gate is mapped at the bottom. Usually clear by mid June (an estimate). Closed or wet? Take the quick way from Buena Vista.

    Pike-San Isabel alerts · ☎ Leadville Ranger District 719-486-0749

  • ⚠ Check · Day 2, fun and Day 2, quick, mile 133-150 (fun), 100-117 (quick)

    Loveland Pass (US 6)

    Closes for snow and wind at any season. I-70's tunnel is the way around.

    cotrip.org

  • ⚠ Check · Day 2, fun and Day 2, quick, mile 150-177 (fun), 116-144 (quick)

    I-70 at Floyd Hill and Idaho Springs

    A long construction zone. Full closures so far are at night (last one found: Nov 2026). Weekend traffic east is heavy after noon.

    CDOT, Nov 9, 2026; live: cotrip.org

  • ✔ No issue found · Day 2, fun and Day 2, quick, mile 128-133 (fun), 95-100 (quick)

    Swan Mountain Road

    Rebuilt in 2025 and 2026; reopened in August 2026. No 2027 work found.

    Summit County

    The line only touches its edge on US 24.

To do

  • 2-3 weeks before: Boreas Pass and Weston Pass open? Call South Park and Leadville.
  • The week before: CDOT (cotrip.org), Pike-San Isabel alerts; ask for a fresh Road Book check.
  • The night before day 1: weather for South Park, fuel range, Gold Water Cafe's hours.
  • Salida, the night before day 2: fun or quick? Wet or smoky: quick.
  • In the bag: rain and warm layers (Boreas 11,481 ft, Loveland 11,990 ft), tire repair, water, printed strip.

If it goes wrong

  • Emergency 911. Assume no signal past Lake George on day 1 and on Weston Pass.
  • Hospitals: Heart of the Rockies, Salida (and a clinic in Buena Vista); St. Anthony Summit, Frisco; emergency room in Breckenridge. Clinics: Fairplay, Idaho Springs.
  • Forest offices: South Park 719-836-2031; Leadville 719-486-0749.
  • Mid-June sunset is about 8:30 pm.

Desk-planned; distances can be off by a few tenths. Hours change: call. Not legal advice; the Forest Service's MVUM is the legal document. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors; relief: USGS The National Map; fire perimeters: NIFC.
